av_event.line_text: Yeah, it's just me, my mum and my little brother, and the dog. My mum's a pharmacist at the hospital, so she works really long shifts.
av_event.what: As she lists her family, Ffion glances off to her right towards the shelf with the framed photo of an older woman. Her smile drops for a second and her lips press together before she looks back at the screen.

text:
B: Hiya, erm, can you hear me okay?
A: Yeah, fine. I'm Leanne.
B: I'm Ffion, I'm in Wrexham. Sorry, I'm a bit nervous, I've never done one of these.
A: No, me neither. I'm near Peterborough. I've just done one, it's alright, they're quite quick.
B: Oh, that's good. Erm, what do you do? Sorry, is that a boring question?
A: No, it's fine. I do the office for my dad's plumbing firm, the books and booking the jobs in. That's why there's all those files.
B: Oh, I did wonder. They look really organised. I'm a student, I'm doing occupational therapy, final year.
A: Oh, right. What's that, like, helping people back into work?
B: Kind of, it's more like helping people do everyday stuff again. I'm on an older adults' ward at the minute, so it's like getting someone washed and dressed, or making sure they're safe to go home. I really like it, the patients are lovely, they tell you all their stories. I just hate the team meetings, I get really nervous having to talk.
A: I'd hate that as well. I'd rather just ring someone and tell them what's what.
B: Yeah, I rehearse what I'm going to say in the car, which is so sad.
A: It's not sad. I do that before I ring people who owe us money.
B: Do you? Oh, that makes me feel better.
A: Do you live with your family then? I live with my mum and dad.
B: Yeah, it's just me, my mum and my little brother, and the dog. My mum's a pharmacist at the hospital, so she works really long shifts.
A: What dog have you got?
B: Bonnie, she's a Jack Russell. She's going a bit deaf now and grey round her nose, bless her.
A: Ours is a Staffie, Bella, she's thirteen. She's got arthritis.
B: Aw. Do you walk her every day?
A: Same loop along the river, every evening. She won't go another way.
B: Bonnie's like that round the park. If I try a different path she just sits down.
A: Yeah, they like what they know. So do I, to be fair.
B: Me too, honestly. Like holidays, we always go to the same hotel in Tenerife.
A: We do that! Same hotel every time. My mum likes knowing where the pool is.
B: Yes, exactly! I went to Benidorm with uni friends once and spent the whole time worrying about my purse.
A: I'd be the same. I get to the airport about four hours early.
B: Oh my God, that's me. Erm, sorry, I don't know what else to ask. What do you watch on telly?
A: Erm, crime stuff. Gogglebox. Gavin & Stacey re-runs, mostly.
B: No way, I'm on about my fifth time watching Gavin & Stacey.
A: It doesn't get old. Friday chippy dinner and Gavin & Stacey, that's my night.
B: We have a chippy tea on Friday as well. Is that weird, that we're the same?
